items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: See, Joe was giving me a job, because he's going to have me to

ctx.x: France. And so, Cal Dickerson said, "Well, that's all now. Let's Just go." Then Joe says, "Well, what about that man over there?" Well, see, Cal Dickerson didn't have -- he really didn't want me. He didn't want me in the band, but I was just in there because Joe had an angle. See, Joe was giving me a job, because he's going to have me to
organize the band for Louis. And I didn't know Louis was telling Joe this, you see.
